subject: physics

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya IPE Study Material for Jr. Students 2026-27 edition, physics volume, Chapter 9 Very Short Answer Question 4 (printed p.98). Only the question was taken; the answer, its steps and its mark split are original work — see docs/ORIGINALITY_MATHS.md. The 1 + 1 mark split is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. Physics hand-checked: hydraulic stress is the restoring force per unit area set up when a fluid compresses a body uniformly; it is a normal stress that changes the volume, not the shape.

insider_note: The mark for "normal stress" is often missed — students name the cause (fluid pressure) but forget to say the force acts normal to every face.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Hydraulic stress — the definition
lines: restoring force per unit area set up
when a fluid compresses a body
steps.margin_note: Say the compression is uniform and from all sides — that is what makes it hydraulic rather than another type of stress.
steps.why: A fluid pushes equally in every direction, so the restoring force it sets up acts normal to every face of the body at once.
common_mistakes: Describing hydraulic stress as acting on only one face, like tensile or compressive stress.
Leaving out the word "uniformly", which is what distinguishes it from an unequal push.
steps.memory_tip: Hydraulic stress comes from a fluid pressing evenly from every side.

steps.label: Nature of the stress
lines: It is a normal stress: the force acts
normal to every face of the body.

lines.text: Hydraulic stress changes volume, not shape.

steps.margin_note: State that the volume changes and the shape does not — that is the second mark, not a repeat of the definition.
steps.why: Since the force acts normal to every face equally, the body's shape is preserved and only its volume shrinks.
common_mistakes: Saying hydraulic stress changes the shape of the body. It changes the volume; the shape stays the same.
Calling it a tangential stress instead of a normal stress.
steps.memory_tip: Squeezed evenly on all sides: the volume shrinks, the shape stays the same.
